scripts.init: npm run init:api && npm run init:app
scripts.init:api: cd api && python -m venv venv && venv\Scripts\activate && pip install fastapi[standard] fastapi_utilities passlib sqlmodel pyjwt pytest && cd ..
scripts.init:mac: npm run init:api:mac && npm run init:app
scripts.init:api:mac: cd api && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip3 install fastapi[standard] fastapi_utilities passlib sqlmodel pyjwt pytest && cd ..
scripts.api: cd api && source venv/bin/activate || venv\Scripts\activate && fastapi dev main.py
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:app
scripts.test:api: cd api && source venv/bin/activate || venv\Scripts\activate && pytest
